Package Domain.Model

Class RespostaEnquesta

java.lang.Object
Domain.Model.RespostaEnquesta
public class RespostaEnquesta extends Object
Represents a survey response (RespostaEnquesta) which groups answers to the individual questions of an associated survey container.

This class holds a list of RespostaAPregunta objects and delegates some aggregate computations (like min/max) to the associated RespostesContainer.

      public RespostaAPregunta getRespostaAPregunta(int ordrePregunta)
